title: John Arcilla is excited to play his biggest villain role to date in his latest horror film
summary: Multi-awarded actor John Arcilla shares with PUSH ABS-CBN what enticed him to accept the role as Regal Entertainment’s exciting new villain in their upcoming slasher film Haunted Carnival.
